method.segmentation: src/energy.py rms_series(800, 160, 16000) + segment(peak_rms=max frame rms); identical to experiments/pause_threshold.py
method.pitch: src/pitch.py YIN, window +/-1.0 s around each pause
method.asr: faster-whisper small.en, CPU int8, word timestamps
method.word_assignment: monotonic sweep onto the energy speech segments; whisper's word times are too coarse to place a pause inside a word but its word order is exact

conjunction.note: a rule is graded as a whole: 'fired' means the rule would YIELD THE FLOOR at that pause
conjunction.syntax_leg: the last word before the pause is not a function word

scenes.name: question, then answer
scenes.purpose: a real hand-off with a real gap

scenes.name: thinking pause
scenes.purpose: B thinks silently, 2-10 s of real silence before any word

scenes.name: turn-holding fillers
scenes.purpose: the negative class: long in practice, no silence at all

scenes.name: one speaker alone, long pauses
scenes.purpose: the pure negative control: silence, no hand-off

scenes.name: room tone
scenes.purpose: the noise floor everything else is measured against

honesty.ground_truth: only the script pair carries ground truth; the free sessions have none and are never counted as if they did
honesty.power: the terminal class is a handful of events; an AUC on this many points is a direction, not a measurement
honesty.classes_never_averaged: the script pair (performed reading) and the free sessions (first-take speech) are reported separately
